items.title: Intact Financial reports Q3 profit decline amid weather losses and UK brand consolidation
items.summary: Intact Financial Corporation's third-quarter net income dropped to CA$562 million as weather catastrophes mounted, while its UK and Ireland operations held direct premiums flat at CA$1.078 billion.

items.title: Vencora acquires CT InsureTech to take permanent ownership of London market bordereaux platform
items.summary: Toronto-based software holding company Vencora has acquired CT InsureTech, bringing a buy-and-hold ownership model to the provider of delegated authority data infrastructure for The London insurance market.

items.title: Hagerty targets £25 million UK revenue following Bennetts motorcycle broker acquisition
items.summary: Collector car insurer Hagerty expects its acquisition of the UK motorcycle broker Bennetts to triple British revenue as global policies in force climb 18.1% to 1.91 million.

items.title: Record UK motor insurance shopping volumes fail to lift switching rates
items.summary: UK motorists shopped for car insurance at a record rate in the first half of 2026, though policyholder switching remained flat at 22% despite rising premiums.

items.title: Fridge hackers reach the UK, exposing cyber and property cover gaps
items.summary: British food businesses have been confirmed as victims of European refrigeration cyberattacks, highlighting a persistent coverage gap between property and cyber insurance policies.

items.title: AIG reports 13% rise in international commercial net premiums for third quarter
items.summary: AIG's international commercial book saw net premiums rise 13% to US$2.4 billion in the third quarter, contrasting with a tougher period in North America.
